_comment: The universal configuration, applied to every launch before any profile. It exists so a program nobody has written a profile for still starts from a known state: Windows 10, which is the version Wine's own wine.inf reports (10.0.19045), written as the per-application AppDefaults value so a profile, a rule or a retry can report a different version for one program without changing the prefix. Nothing here is a workaround for a title; a workaround belongs in compat/rules.json, compat/recipes.json or a game profile.
